decision: The current PMXT one-off path is not a custom backtesting engine. It reuses pinned NautilusTrader Polymarket parser/model surfaces, ParquetDataCatalog, and BacktestNode wherever NT exposes them for this bounded historical proof. Bolt-owned PMXT code remains necessary only at the raw historical archive boundary: configured Parquet column decoding, selected-source/report-chain validation, duplicate historical trade observation policy, provenance, and claim-limit enforcement.

nt_surfaces_reused_by_current_pmxt_one_o.purpose: Decode Gamma market metadata into NT Polymarket instrument definitions.
Create NT InstrumentAny::BinaryOption for the selected Polymarket token.
Convert selected PMXT book snapshot rows into NT OrderBookDelta batches with NT snapshot semantics.
Convert selected PMXT price_change rows into NT OrderBookDelta batches.

nt_surfaces_reused_by_current_pmxt_one_o.surface: nautilus_model::data::TradeTick and NT Price/Quantity/TradeId model types
nt_surfaces_reused_by_current_pmxt_one_o.purpose: Represent selected PMXT last_trade_price rows as NT-native TradeTick values.
Write selected PMXT instruments, OrderBookDelta rows, and TradeTick rows into an NT catalog.
Consume the verified NT catalog through the NT backtest path and produce BacktestResult evidence.

nt_surfaces_checked_but_not_available_as.finding: This is an HTTP Data API historical trade client, not a PMXT hourly Parquet L2 archive reader.
This parser is private to the NT Polymarket crate and expects Data API trade models, not PMXT last_trade_price Parquet rows.

The helper is pub(crate), so Bolt cannot call it directly. The PMXT one-off adapter mirrors its transaction_hash+asset+sequence shape and adds duplicate-observation collapse because PMXT rows can include repeated observations with distinct timestamp_received values.

BacktestDataConfig dispatch supports market data classes such as OrderBookDelta, TradeTick, InstrumentStatus, and InstrumentClose, but not scheduled InstrumentAny definition updates. This leaves dynamic tick-size replay unresolved for full PMXT L2 acceptance.

bolt_owned_boundaries_that_remain_valid: Decode configured PMXT Parquet columns and event families from the selected-source schema.
Validate selected-source report hashes, source binding, usage_scope, selected asset hash, and artifact-root provenance.
Collapse exact duplicate historical trade observations before creating NT TradeTick values.
Mirror pinned NT's historical transaction_hash+asset+sequence TradeId shape until NT exposes a public reusable helper or batch PMXT reader.
Reject or block tick_size_change claims until a timed instrument-epoch replay path or source-proof-bound exclusion policy is accepted.
Keep PMXT scoped to one_off_backfill_data; do not promote it to canonical broad backfill evidence from the bounded proof.

rejected_alternatives.alternative: Build a custom backtesting engine for PMXT
rejected_alternatives.reason: NT already provides ParquetDataCatalog, BacktestNode, OrderBookDelta, TradeTick, and Polymarket parser/model surfaces needed for the bounded one-off proof.

rejected_alternatives.alternative: Treat the NT Polymarket live adapter as a PMXT batch archive reader
rejected_alternatives.reason: Pinned NT exposes live websocket/data-api clients and parsers, not a PMXT hourly Parquet archive ingestion path.

rejected_alternatives.alternative: Ignore PMXT duplicate historical trade observations
rejected_alternatives.reason: PMXT can repeat semantic trade rows with different timestamp_received values; counting them twice would overstate historical volume.

rejected_alternatives.alternative: Claim full PMXT dynamic tick-size replay through standard BacktestNode catalog data configs
rejected_alternatives.reason: Standard BacktestDataConfig catalog replay does not schedule InstrumentAny updates as timestamped Data items.

next_required_evidence: For one-off selected PMXT proofs, keep proving catalog read-back and BacktestNode consumption through NT ParquetDataCatalog instead of a custom engine.

Before broad PMXT backfill, prove manifest/index-only coverage, accepted source proof, bounded byte/row/time budgets, and dynamic tick-size replay or a source-proof-bound no-tick-size-change universe.
If NT later exposes a public PMXT archive reader or public historical trade-id helper, replace the mirrored Bolt adapter code with the NT surface and update this boundary artifact.
